connector.name: Eleion Scanner
connector.registryDescription: Register/verify your domains, queue security scans, and read findings (CVE, severity).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package eleion-scanner-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hernaninverso account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCANNER_API_KEY
env.description: Tenant API key from https://scan.eleion.io (you can only scan domains you own and have verified)
